claims.citation: New York Herald, 24 May 1866, p. 5, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Bark William Van Name, Knight, Messina, 44[?] days, with
fruit, &c, to Chamberlain, Phelps & Co. May 1, lat 35 45, lon
39 20, signalized ship Juliet Trundy, steering SSW; 17th, lat
42 14, lon 61, spoke bark C H Jones, from Bordeaux for New
York, 50[?] days out.
